annotations.title: Watch a domain for broken ad tracking

description: WATCH A DOMAIN'S AD TRACKING: Hermoso re-audits its homepage every day (the same audit as audit_conversion_tracking) and emails the account's address when tracking BREAKS: a score drop of 5 points or more, an ad pixel that stops firing or disappears, a pixel that starts firing before the cookie banner is answered, a server-side path that disappears, or a new duplicate, failing or blocked install. A break is confirmed by a second scan before any email goes out. Watching a domain already watched returns it with created:false. Up to 25 domains per account. Free.

url.description: the domain (or any URL on it) to watch
